scores.notes: Temple court with a gold-banded, blue-robed man working at a chest among workers storing blank scrolls, a priest with a jar and the bronze basin on oxen; no marks on the scrolls and painted to every edge.
Holmes's face clearly reads as the actor Peter Cushing (frontal, centre right). Otherwise the moment is shown: Hatherley points at the burning whitewashed house, fire engine and crowd on the right.
Fire streaks from dark cloud onto two walled cities on the plain; only small fleeing groups on the road, no figure in the sky.

Marks: glyphs on the Hatter's hat tag, a tiny corner index on the heart card behind him, heart pips and squiggle lines on the papers on the floor, none readable as words. The court guards (left of the table and right foreground) are ordinary humans in red coats and tricorns rather than flat cards; Hatter, Hare, Dormouse, King, Queen and jurors with slates are otherwise shown.
One hillside tableau of the named ancestors: an aged patriarch blessing a child on the left and a crowned king with a harp in the centre; no lettering, painted to the edges.
Daniel stands unharmed among four calm lions in the pit with a soft glow behind him (no angel figure), the king kneeling at the rim with a torch.

The men with the ropes stand inside the pit at the bottom edge and pull ropes Daniel holds while he stands on the floor, so nobody could lift him out; the glad king reaching down from the rim is right. No lions visible.

Left side fades to bare white paper (accepted). Holmes lashes his cane at the bell cord under the smoking ventilator with a lit match while Watson shields his eyes on the bed; Holmes is an aged profile that does not clearly read as a real actor.
White paper shows on all four edges (accepted). A pig in a wattle pen with a priest in a twelve-stone breastplate gesturing at it and the camp behind; no marks on the breastplate, no divine figure.

Small garbled stencil marks on the crate behind the lantern, centre. Holmes kneels with lantern and lens at the flagstones while Merryweather sulks on a crate; his bowed face does not clearly read as a real actor.
Moses on a rock with staff raised and arm out over a stormy sea as a wet path opens between the waves; crowd with donkeys, nothing figure-like in the sky.
Night storm with waves breaking into the boat and men bailing, Jesus asleep on the cushion in the stern; painted to every edge, other boats in the distance.

Moses sits on the stone but holds both arms up unaided: Aaron and Hur both stand on his left, one only gripping the staff, and neither holds up a hand. White paper along the top, left and bottom-left (accepted).
Moses with staff and outstretched arm before a sea split by a dry path, crowd on both sides; the light on the horizon is a plain pillar of flame, not a figure.

Marks: a garbled pseudo-masthead on the newspaper draped over Watson's chair (top left), blurred print on the papers at right and a clock face, none readable as words. Holmes's face clearly reads as the actor Peter Cushing (three-quarter view, right); the hat-and-lens moment is shown.

Marks: tick marks on the mantel clock face (right) and scribble lines on the papers lower left. Holmes's face clearly reads as the actor Peter Cushing (profile, left). The masked giant in fur-trimmed coat and flame-lined blue cloak enters with Watson in the armchair; painted to the edges.
Moses with staff outstretched, the sea parted around a wet path and a swirling flame-and-cloud pillar on the horizon that is not human-shaped; crowd with children.
The people walk on sand between two towering walls of water, led by an elder with a staff, with animals and shells underfoot.
The father reaches toward the ragged barefoot son while a servant brings a rich robe and a boy carries sandals; a ring shows on the father's hand.
At a city gate people look up rejoicing at a golden swirling wind with coins on a table and full grain sacks; the swirls are neither glyphs nor a figure, so Wisdom is not drawn.
White paper on all four edges (accepted). A prophet holding a book gestures over a valley strewn with bones; no divine figure.
Courtyard fire with Peter standing in the foreground holding a net and Jesus small in the far doorway turned toward him, soldiers and servants around; no lettering.

Marks: scribble lines on the note in Holmes's hands and garbled mastheads on the newspapers on the desk, right; none readable. Holmes's face clearly reads as the actor Peter Cushing (three-quarter view, centre). Lestrade bends and points at the paper with Watson seated.
Daniel stands before the crowned king at the feast with a scroll case at his hip; no writing is drawn on the wall or anywhere else.

Marks: heart pips on the card arches and on the Queen's card body and collar, not readable text. The Cat's head, Alice whispering and the smiling Queen close behind her are shown; pale washes reach every edge.
A column of people with tents sets out from a cloud-capped mountain toward the hill country; no figure in the cloud.

The largest figure is an elder gesturing beside an unmarked scroll on the bench, reading as a narrator presenting the family group on the left, with a Roman soldier far right; nobody reads as David or Abraham.

Small bare-paper patches at the bottom corners (accepted). The king presses his signet into wax on the stone while a lord adds a second; the pit beside the stone is still partly open with lions visible.
A crowd with donkeys leaves the mountain toward open hill country; no lettering and no divine figure.

Pseudo-script on the Hatter's hat tag. A second dormouse in the same blue waistcoat sleeps under the table (bottom centre) while the Dormouse also dozes at the table. White paper on the left, right and bottom edges (accepted).
Three generations in one pastoral landscape: a man with women and a baby, a man with a boy, and an old man with a shepherd youth among sheep.
A man peers at his dim reflection in a tarnished mirror on a stand while others watch, a harbour through the doorway; no lettering.
Daniel is hauled up out of the den on a rope with the king above arms open in gladness and lions lying below; attendants steady guide ropes in the pit.

Thin band of white paper with a rough inked edge all round (accepted). Holmes lashes his cane at the bell-pull with the snake by the ventilator, match lit, Watson on the bed; the stylised profile does not clearly read as a real actor.
Bald Elisha on the path up to a walled town while boys point and laugh at him; hands and faces sound.

Marks: numeral-like ticks on the mantel clock face and squiggle lines on the papers lower left. Holmes's face clearly reads as the actor Peter Cushing (three-quarter view, centre). White paper at the bottom corners and right edge (accepted).
David stoops at the brook putting a stone in his shepherd's bag, sling and staff in hand, with the giant and his army in the distance.
A prophet with arm raised speaks over rows of skeletons in a dry valley; no divine figure, painted to the edges.

Marks: squiggle lines and a heading-like scrawl on the sheets and envelopes on the desk, lower left. Holmes's face clearly reads as the actor Peter Cushing (near profile, left). Holmes holds the blue stone to the window by the strong box; white paper on three edges (accepted).
David in sling follow-through as the giant pitches face-down with the stone by his head; no blood, the pale top edge is painted sky.
Jesus asleep on a cushion in the stern as three disciples rouse him and others bail and fight the sail in the storm.
